title: CR functions at CR singularities approximation, extension, and hulls

predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The proof reads: "To see that it is closed, suppose p₁ ∈ SADH_q(X). For any ε > 0 there is a p₂ ∈ SADH_q(X) that is within ε/2 of p₁ ... As ε > 0 was arbitrary, p₁ ∈ SADH_q(X)." The hypothesis must be that p₁ lies in the *closure* of SADH_q(X); as written the argument assumes what it concludes and proves nothing about closedness. The whole point of the approximation step (choosing p₂ within ε/2 of p₁) only makes sense for a limit point of the set.

The example claims to produce a *compact* set X with non-compact disc hull, but X as defined in (5) only contains points with z₃ = 1/k, k ∈ ℕ, so it is not closed (it accumulates on the set z₃ = 0) and hence not compact. Moreover, the subsequent argument explicitly treats discs with z₃ = 0 attached to X and asserts "β(ζ) = φ∞(α(ζ)): the disc is attached, and that is the only possible z₂-coordinate", which presupposes that X contains the limiting set {z₁ ∈ ∂𝔻, z₂ = φ∞(z₁), z₃ = 0}. The definition of X is therefore incomplete/inconsistent with the proof and with the compactness hypothesis of the example.

X₂ in (8) is defined with the strict inequality "Im z₂ < 0", but the computed disc hull in (9) contains the full set {|z₁| ≤ 2, |z₂| = 1, Im z₂ ≤ 0}, including points with Im z₂ = 0 and |z₁| = 2 that are not reachable by any disc attached to X (every attached disc has z₂ constant with Im z₂ < 0). Also, with the strict inequality X is not compact, inconsistent with the later analogous construction (10) for X′, which uses Im z₂ ≤ 0 and is asserted to be compact. One of the two inequalities must be corrected.

predicted_errors.error_location: Proof of Theorem 2.3(ii) vs. Section 2 preceding paragraph / Introduction
predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The text just before Theorem 2.3 states that the failure of the Baouendi–Trèves conclusion (and hence the strict inclusion CR ⊋ CR_P) is shown in "Theorem 5.1 or Theorem 9.1", while the proof of Theorem 2.3(ii) cites "Theorem 5.1 or Theorem 8.1". Section 8 is described in the Introduction as establishing the strong iterated SADH condition for w = z̄₁z₂ (a positive extension result), not the strict inclusion CR^k ⊋ CR_P^k; the cross-reference appears to be wrong.
